title: Vulkanizium
description: Vulkanizium, is optimization modpack for smoother server experience.
body:
Vulkanizium is Vulkan Mod based optimization modpack. If you wanted to get render optimization with Vulkan Mod, You should to download Vulkanizium! With that modpack, you won't have to choose compatible mods, everything is alreadly installed and configured. Modpack goals: 1. Optimize Minecraft for weak PC's  
 2. Ensure the best server gaming experience 
 3. Can be used for speedruns or challenges
 Why? Vulkanizium needs only 1-1,5GB free RAM, have mods for optimizing ping and player loading and haven't "cheat" mods, witch are prohibited for speedruns.
 Requremets for Vulkan Mod: videoadapter, that support Vulkan 1.2
 Good luck!
